question: “Ramsar Convention” is related to _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wetland Conservation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ramsar **Convention basically belongs to** Wetland Conservation.**
 
• The Convention on Wetlands is an **intergovernmental treaty **that provides the framework for the conservation and wise use of **wetlands.**
 
• The Convention was **adopted** in the **Iranian city** of **Ramsar** in **1971 **and **came into force in 1975.**
 
• Since then, almost 90% of UN member states, from all the world’s geographic regions, have acceded to become “Contracting Parties”.
 
• **Ramsar** identifies **wetlands of international importance**, especially those providing **waterfowl habitat.**
 
• Its broad **aims** are to** halt the worldwide loss of wetlands and to conserve, through wise use and management**.
